dimensions.label: Correctness
dimensions.description: Does the fix normalize email correctly (trim, lowercase domain, preserve local)?
dimensions.pass_if: All test cases in tests/check.sh pass with exit code 0

dimensions.label: Edge Case Handling
dimensions.description: Does the fix handle empty input, missing @, multiple @, whitespace?
dimensions.pass_if: Edge case tests in tests/check.sh pass

dimensions.label: Style & Minimality
dimensions.description: Is the fix minimal and idiomatic?
dimensions.pass_if: The fix changes only the function body; no unnecessary imports or refactors
